decisions.reason: The multi-model illuminated candle arch line sits close to the core Erzgebirge-style offer, and its development and home-page promotion are sunk investments, so management will keep it despite the lack of recent visibility.
The one-tier pyramid is a traditional core item that needs little extra investment to stay in the seasonal range, so with industry turnover growing there is little reason to drop it.

As the publicly presented flagship line with several models and substantial development investment, the electronic music box is something management will persist with, attributing weak results to pandemic-era disruptions and start-up effects even though the companion platforms were already cut.

The Dresden-themed pyramid builds on the established craft offer and fits regional gift demand, so management will keep it, though as a single themed model it is somewhat more exposed to range pruning.
